title: Teaching Large Language Models: Code, Data, and Materials
description:
Reproducibility package for Baffour (2026), Teaching Large Language Models: A Pipeline-Centered Course Design and Mixed-Methods Evidence From a Cross-Listed Undergraduate/Graduate Offering, Journal of Information Technology Education: Innovations in Practice.

Contains the de-identified survey and coursework data, the Python analysis code that regenerates every table, figure, and statistic in the paper, and reusable course and evaluation materials: the survey instrument, qualitative codebook, stage-to-assessment mapping, difficulty-matrix protocol, and the Pipeline Debugger activity template.
notes: Code is licensed under MIT. Data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
